تشتهون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَهُونَ (taštahūna) /taʃ.ta.huː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# تُشْتَهَوْنَ (tuštahawna) /tuʃ.ta.haw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
